name: Zenotech Laboratories Limited
about: Zenotech Laboratories Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical specialty generic injectables in the oncology and anesthesiology markets in India. It offers contract manufacturing services for parenteral depot formulations, ophthalmic, oncology oral and injectables, and general injectables. The company also leases out its biotech facility and equipment. Zenotech Laboratories Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
